paired_summary.interpretation: descriptive paired microbenchmark result; not a confidence interval or general performance claim

protocol.correctness: every warmup and measured invocation must report exact output b'3', 1,000 completed calls, zero child launches, and the frozen workload/input/output hashes
protocol.interpretation_limit: fixed local paired microbenchmark; no confidence interval, cold-start, sustained-load, or general workload claim
protocol.metric: within-invocation median of 3 raw runtime::run durations; per-pair candidate minus baseline; report median of 48 paired deltas
protocol.pair_order: global pairs alternate AB/BA, beginning AB; measured pairs are balanced and begin BA
